Union List, State List and Concurrent List: who makes laws on which subject. Class 10 Political Science, Federalism.

• Union List: national subjects like defence, banking and currency; only the Union makes laws
• State List: police, trade, agriculture, irrigation; only the States make laws
• Concurrent List: education, forests, marriage; both can, and if laws conflict the Union's law is followed
• Residuary subjects like computer software: the Union makes the laws
